'''Kurtuln Den''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Den (Selonian)|den]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], in the caves beneath [[Kystes' Spine]]. [[Magalak]] was a champion of the den.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
